ValidationRule.description: Only Sales Operations and Sales Admin profile should have access to edit backout fields.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( OR( AND( $Permission.Edit_Closed_Won_Create_Box_Folder , ISCHANGED( Create_Box_com_Folder_s__c ) ), AND( $Permission.Edit_Opportunity_Max_Orientation_Date , ISCHANGED( Max_Orientation_Date__c ) ) )), AND( OR( ISCHANGED( NSP_Forecast__c ) , ISCHANGED( NSP_Back_Out__c ) , ISCHANGED( NSP_Back_Out_By__c ) , ISCHANGED( NSP_BackOutDate__c ) , ISCHANGED( NSP_BackOutReason__c ) , ISCHANGED( NSP_BackOutRequestor__c ) , ISCHANGED( NSP_Booked_Date__c ) ), AND( $Permission.Locked_Opportunity_Backout_Access ) ), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Closed Won') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Once Opportunity is Closed Won it cannot be modified. Please contact Sales Operations team
